title: chrysanthemum subglaucum
intro: Chrysanthemum subglaucum, commonly known as Huzhang or Chinese Honeysuckle, is a perennial herb native to China and other parts of Asia, belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower fever, reduce inflammation, and alleviate digestive issues. The health benefits of Chrysanthemum subglaucum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and diuretic effects. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum subglaucum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
